description: What a starting sum plus a monthly amount grows to at an annual rate (as an AER) over a number of years, and how much of that is growth. Can also say how often interest is added, pay in at the start of each month, raise the monthly amount each year, or work backwards from a target: the monthly amount needed, or how long it takes. Also says roughly how long money takes to double. Use for 'what will £10k become at 5% over 20 years' or 'how much a month to reach £50k in 10 years'.

annualRatePct.description: The annual rate, e.g. 5 for 5%. An AER unless interestAdded says otherwise.

interestAdded.description: How often interest is added: 'aer' (the rate is what the year adds up to, as UK savings quote it), 'daily', 'monthly' or 'yearly'. Defaults to aer.

monthlyContribution.description: Added each month, in pounds. Defaults to 0. Left out when working out the monthly amount for a target.

payAt.description: Pay in at the start or the end of each month. Defaults to end.

target.description: A target to work backwards from. With years: the monthly amount needed. Without years: how long it takes.

yearlyRisePct.description: Raise the monthly amount by this percentage each year, e.g. 3. Defaults to 0.

years.description: How many years. Leave out with a target to find how long it takes.

name: calculate_compound_growth
title: Compound interest
